transcript.answer: Otto was never built on Cloud Run in europe-north1. The plan (#27) chose that region to sit "in the same region as the Vertex model", but that premise no longer holds. Measured on 2026-10-16, europe-north1 serves only the Gemini 2.5 family, which Google retires on 2026-10-20. The newer Gemini models answer only on the `eu` multi-region. The model's `global` endpoint was rejected because it gives up the EU residency the model allowlist exists to enforce. The planned Cloud Run terraform roots (shared/, environments/poc/, bootstrap/), the deploy-poc.yaml workflow and docs/adr/ADR-001-hosting-platform.md were also never built. Otto instead deploys with Helm to the shared GKE Autopilot cluster `n8n-cluster` in project `re5-n8n-platform`, region europe-west1. ADR-003 (decided 2026-10-19) records this, and #27, #162 and #168 were closed as superseded.
